Aurora Field Instruments Onboarding Handbook
Your first week
On day one you meet your buddy, Lucas Meyer, at 9:30 in the lobby.
- Collect your badge
- Set up your laptop
- Book the safety briefing
Time off
Full-time staff receive 10 days of paid leave per year, plus public holidays.
Practical things
Guest Wi-Fi network: Aurora-Guest. The office opens at 7:30 and closes at 20:00.
This handbook is synthetic data for evaluation only.
